Q: Having trouble translating blob file into image on NextJS App from MongoDB A:

A blob: URL isn’t a real image URL that can be stored or reused. It’s a temporary link created by the browser only for the current session, usually for previewing a file right after a user selects it.

Because of that:

  • Blob URLs only work in the same browser session where they were created
  • They break after a page refresh
  • They shouldn’t be saved in the database
  • next/image doesn’t support blob: URLs

That’s why the image isn’t showing up when you try to load it from the backend.

The correct flow is to use blob URLs only for local previews, then upload the image to your server or storage (like S3 or local uploads), save the image’s public URL or file path in the database, and render that URL on the frontend.

Q: How to exclude subtotal lines from result A:

Try:

^(?<nimetus>Service\d*)[^\r\n]*(?<sum>\d+)(?:\s+\d+){2}$

See: regex101

Explanation

  • ^(?<nimetus>Service\d*)(?<sum>\d+): Get the start of a line when it starts with literal 'Service' and any amount of subsequent digits and capture to "nimetus".
  • [^\r\n]*: Then skip forward without going to a new line
  • (?<sum>\d+): and grab the 3rd to last element which contains digits and capture to "sum".
  • (?:\s+\d+){2}$: Ensure 3rd to last by forcing two more groups to come before the end of string, identified by 2 more spacial separators.

Q: How to append single quote in mysql A: 
SELECT CONCAT(
  '''',
  REPLACE(
    REPLACE(
      'IT,Business,IT & ERP Software Development, IT Services, ERP Solution,Industrial Supply,IT & Software Development',
      ', ',
      ','
    ),
    ',',
    ''','''
  ),
  ''''
) AS result;

Q: Shared Server cum VPS A:

Running Java apps on shared environments can get tricky, especially with Tomcat configuration limits. From my experience, a vps or small serveur privé gives much more control for deploying .war files and tuning JVM settings properly. I’ve worked on similar setups using <a href="https://www.univirtual.ch/en/business-core/virtualization-telecommunication/virtual-server">UNIVIRTUAL</a> as a provider, and having root access really simplified Tomcat management compared to classic shared hosting.

Q: ChainedAssignmentError when adding a conditional to a pandas dataframe A:

This seems to be an updated (and much more informative!) version of the old SettingWithCopyWarning, preparing for pandas 3.0. For in-depth discussion see this answer.

The warning message is very clear in your case: change to a single assignment with

df.loc[df.loc[:,"one"] == "e", "Match"] = 1
